name: codex-governspec
description: Use GovernSpec task contracts from Codex through a local skill and MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Validate, compile, and test GovernSpec task contracts from Codex.
interface.longDescription: GovernSpec for Codex connects local-first AI task contracts to Codex through a skill and the governspec-mcp server. Use it to recognize govern.yaml contracts, validate constraints, compile downstream artifacts such as AGENTS.md or structured output payloads, and run deterministic offline acceptance tests.
